name: mirror-mind
description: Mirror Mind — local-first memory and identity for agentic runtimes.

args: mmbin=""; [ -n "$MIRROR_BIN" ] && [ -x "$MIRROR_BIN/mirror" ] && mmbin="$MIRROR_BIN/mirror"; [ -n "$mmbin" ] || mmbin="$(command -v mirror 2>/dev/null)"; for mmdir in "$HOME/.nvm/current/bin" /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin; do [ -n "$mmbin" ] && break; [ -x "$mmdir/mirror" ] && mmbin="$mmdir/mirror"; done; [ -n "$mmbin" ] || { echo "mirror-mind: mirror not found on PATH; the MCP server cannot start. Install mirror-mind (npm install -g mirror-mind) or set MIRROR_BIN to its bin directory." >&2; exit 1; }; mmnode="$MIRROR_NODE"; [ -n "$mmnode" ] && [ -x "$mmnode" ] || mmnode="$(command -v node 2>/dev/null)"; for mmdir in "$(dirname "$mmbin")" "$HOME/.nvm/current/bin" /opt/homebrew/bin /usr/local/bin; do [ -n "$mmnode" ] && break; [ -x "$mmdir/node" ] && mmnode="$mmdir/node"; done; [ -n "$mmnode" ] || { echo "mirror-mind: node not found on PATH; the MCP server cannot start. Set MIRROR_NODE." >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$mmnode" "$mmbin" mcp
